name: @equin/plugin-primitives-css-resizable
description: Resizable panel groups (react-resizable-panels) in the ui-kit look: ResizablePanelGroup, ResizablePanel and ResizableHandle. Its own plugin, not a ui-kit export, so the package loads only on pages that split a surface into resizable panels — as a ui-kit export it was preloaded by every page that imports cn().
